name: ESP32-H2 Thread migration for homebrew ESPHome devices

mentions.name: ESP32-H2 Thread migration for homebrew ESPHome devices
mentions.description: An ongoing refactoring of homebrew ESPHome devices to run on the ESP32-H2 for native Thread support, enabling removal of weak IoT Wi-Fi SSIDs while expanding the Thread network's node count for better mesh coverage.
mentions.problem: Wi-Fi IoT devices create weak SSIDs, while a Thread-based mesh expands node count for better connectivity.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently I'm refactoring a lot of homebrew ESPhome devices to use the ESP32-H2 as it supports Thread. This allows me to remove weak IoT SSIDs while expanding my Thread network node count for better mesh.

evidence.value: Currently I'm refactoring a lot of homebrew ESPhome devices to use the ESP32-H2 as it supports Thread. This allows me to remove weak IoT SSIDs while expanding my Thread network node count for better mesh.
